# Known issues and limitations

<!-- docsync:auto:begin - generated by docsync, edits inside this block are overwritten -->
> **Section status: CURRENT** - reviewed 2026-11-24; not tied to specific files, so it never goes stale.
<!-- docsync:auto:end -->

| Issue | Impact | Workaround | Where in code | Planned fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `library_service.create_library` and `update_library` reference an undefined `_HEADERS` (NameError) | `POST` and `PUT /api/libraries` return 500. The agent pipeline's library provisioning always reports `created: False`. Workflow document inputs cannot get their library, so file uploads on run forms fail. | Create libraries in the Mistral console and select them | `backend/app/services/library_service.py`; callers `layers/agent/library_provisioning_layer.py`, `workflow_inputs/documents.py` | None recorded. Define the headers or use the SDK. |
| Tool Service `SynthesizeRequest` lacks `feedback` and `regression_inputs` | Rebuild-from-error feedback and regression cases sent by the backend are silently dropped by Pydantic, so rebuilds do not see them | None | `tool-service/app/schemas.py`; sender `backend/app/core/specs.as_request` | None recorded. Add both fields. |
| Approved tools run in-process at `/execute` (importlib), not in the sandbox | A hung or memory-hungry approved tool can stall the Tool Service, which runs as root in Docker. The Settings text implies that the sandbox limits apply to executions. | Review tools before approving; restart the Tool Service | `tool-service/app/synthesis/registry.py`, `services/execution_service.py` | None recorded |
| `PROCESS_COVERAGE_BLOCKING` defaults to True while a comment says coverage never blocks | Planning can stop on missing process coverage, which surprises users | Set it to False on the Settings page | `backend/app/config.py`, `layers/workflow/finalize_layers.py` | Decide the intended default |
| `NEO4J_PASSWORD` has a hard-coded default in `config.py`, and the root compose has a default `NEO4J_AUTH` | Weak default credentials if not overridden | Always set `NEO4J_PASSWORD` / `NEO4J_AUTH` | `backend/app/config.py`, `docker-compose.yml` | Remove the defaults |
| `workflow_input_libraries` and `workflow_input_documents` are not workspace-scoped and are unique on `(workflow_name, field)` | Two workspaces with a same-named workflow share one input-library row (the library lives in the first workspace's Mistral account) | Use distinct workflow names across workspaces | `backend/app/workflow_inputs/models.py`, `auth/setup.py` | Register them as scoped |
| `remote_provider_accounts` is one row per provider, platform-wide; the Brev CLI login is host-wide | Cloud credentials saved by one workspace's user can list and start VMs for every workspace | Only let trusted maintainers manage provider accounts | `backend/app/remote_server_model.py`, `remote_servers/accounts.py` | Confirm whether this is intended |
| `select_rules` returns `process_refs` but not `guidance_refs` | Guidance used by rule selection is never recorded in knowledge feedback | None | `backend/app/rules/select.py`, `layers/workflow/rule_layers.py` | None recorded |
| `backend/scripts/brev_deploy.py`, `backend/re_register.py` and `test_assets/scripts/smoke_test.py` call `/api` without signing in | They likely get 401 now that auth is on (unverified) | Add a login step, or run them before auth existed | Those scripts | None recorded |
| The settings core is duplicated and has drifted | The backend has a `json` setting type that the Tool Service copy lacks | Keep `json` settings backend-only | `backend/app/app_settings/core.py`, `tool-service/app/runtime_config.py` | Port it, or share the code |
| `tool-service/.env.example` uses a relative `DATABASE_URL`, and its comment names the fallback `mistral-large-2512` (the code uses `mistral-large-4`) | With that `.env` in Docker, the database is outside the `tool-db` volume and is lost on recreate | Use `sqlite:////app/db/tool_service.db` | `tool-service/.env.example` | Fix the template |
| `backend/.env.example` sets `MISTRAL_WORKER_ENABLED=false` while the code default is True | Developers who copy the template never start the worker | Set it to true when needed | `backend/.env.example` | Align them |
| `cryptography` is missing from `backend/requirements.txt` | A clean venv without paramiko fails on import | `pip install cryptography` (the Dockerfile does this) | `backend/requirements.txt` | Add it |
| The built-in `send_email` tool is a mock that reports success; `calculate` uses `eval` | Agents may claim emails were sent; `eval` on model-provided input | Do not give these tools to production agents | `tool-service/app/seed_native_tools.py` | None recorded |
| The root `README.md` describes the legacy frontend (port 5173) and has no accounts, Neo4j or deployment | Misleads new developers | Use `DEPLOYMENT.md` and these replication docs | `README.md` | Rewrite it |
| `frontend/src/features/ontology/QueryTab.tsx` contains literal NUL separators | Tools treat it as binary (legacy frontend only) | None needed (not built) | `frontend/` | n/a (legacy) |
| `deploy/.env.example` is undocumented here | The production template's variables are known only from the compose file and `deploy.sh` | Read the file directly | `deploy/.env.example` | Document it once it can be read |

## Technical debt
- **Dead code:**
  - `tool-service/app/prompts.py` (unused);
  - in `backend/app/prompts.py`, `ORCHESTRATOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT`/`USER_PROMPT`, `WORKFLOW_ANALYSIS_*` and `WORKFLOW_DAG_*` are no longer imported anywhere (the layered pipelines replaced them);
  - `LIGHT = "mistral-small-2603"` in the backend routes is unused (the Tool Service uses its `LIGHT` for `runtime_fallback`);
  - `backend/rewrite.py` is obsolete; `cleanup_fresh_start.py` is superseded by Settings → Cleanup;
  - `mock_tools/`, `scratch_tools.json` and `generate_report.py` at the root.
- **Legacy aliases:** `backend/app/ontology/*` re-exports `app/catalog`; `backend/app/process_knowledge/*` re-exports `app/process`. They are kept for old imports.
- **Superseded frontend:** `frontend/` (the Vite SPA) is still in the tree.
- **Stale documents:** `openapi.yaml`, `architecture.md`, `analysis.md`, `implementation_plan.md`, `hybrid_architecture_implementation.md`, `api_documentation.md`, `mistral-agent-frontend-spec.md`, `LOVABLE_FRONTEND_SPEC.md`, `extracted_docs.txt`, `workflows_doc.txt`, `sitemap_summary.txt`.
- **Duplicated logic:**
  - model routing exists in both services (`llm_routes.py` and `tool-service/app/llm/routes.py`, with different role tables);
  - the settings core is copied;
  - the backend and Tool Service each have their own `AUTO_APPROVE_DYNAMIC_TOOLS`, with opposite defaults.
- **Half-finished:**
  - the commented MCP containers in `tool-service/docker-compose.yml`;
  - `mistralai-search-toolkit` is optional, with a native fallback in `rag/optimizer.py`.
- **No Python lock file and mostly unpinned requirements.** The Brev CLI is fetched as "latest" at build time.
- **Stray files** at the root and in `backend/`: `sql_app.db`, `tools.json`, `backend/.mistral_workflows/`, `backend/mistral_workflows/`.
